name: Radiology Operations
description: Go-live and steady-state metrics for the care_radiology plugin: rollout readiness, imaging volume, the order-to-report funnel, turnaround times, open backlog, PACS growth, and the integration/data-quality exceptions that fail silently. SQL sources: dashboard-configs/sql/radiology-kpis/.
caveats: Scan start/end come from the MPPS webhook log, which records that an event was accepted -- not that it was applied. Report timestamps use DiagnosticReport.modified_date; there is no finalised_at column. Device volume is room volume: CARE stores no study-to-device link.

card.name: Radiology Readiness & Adoption by Facility
card.description: Configuration completeness and usage per facility. ROLLOUT_STAGE and GAPS are the go-live checklist.

stages.native:
-- KPI 1: Radiology Readiness & Adoption by Facility
--
-- Go-live card. One row per active facility, answering "is radiology actually
-- switched on here, and is anyone using it?". Everything to the left of
-- IMAGING_ORDERS_TOTAL is configuration; everything to the right is usage.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  -- Reporting window in IST. period_end is the exclusive upper bound, so the card is
  -- reproducible for any past window instead of drifting with NOW().
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'     AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_end
  ),
  -- Radiology procedures are ActivityDefinitions with classification 'imaging'; the
  -- same literal the plugin matches ServiceRequest.category against
  -- (CARE_RADIOLOGY_RADIOLOGY_CATEGORY, default "imaging").
  imaging_defs AS (
    SELECT
      ad.facility_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ad.status = 'active' AND ad.latest)                        AS active_procedures,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ad.category_id) FILTER (WHERE ad.status = 'active' AND ad.latest)  AS procedure_categories,
      -- A procedure with no locations never appears in any modality worklist.
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE ad.status = 'active' AND ad.latest AND COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(ad.locations, 1), 0) = 0
      )                                                                                 AS procedures_without_location
    FROM emr_activitydefinition ad
    WHERE ad.deleted = FALSE
      AND ad.classification = 'imaging'
    GROUP BY ad.facility_id
  ),
  devices AS (
    SELECT
      d.facility_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.care_type = 'dicom-enabler')                             AS dicom_enablers,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.care_type = 'dicom')                                     AS modality_devices,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE d.care_type = 'dicom' AND d.metadata ->> 'assignment_status' = 'assigned'
      )                                                                                 AS assigned_modalities,
      -- worklist_devices(): active + available + placed in a room. Anything short of
      -- this is invisible to the DICOM Enabler.
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE d.care_type = 'dicom'
          AND d.status = 'active'
          AND d.availability_status = 'available'
          AND d.current_location_id IS NOT NULL
      )                                                                                 AS worklist_ready_modalities,
      -- Guarded cast: last_synced_at is free-form JSON, so a non-ISO value reads as
      -- "never synced" instead of aborting the card.
      MAX(
        CASE WHEN d.care_type = 'dicom' AND d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
             THEN (d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ END
      )                                                                                 AS last_modality_sync_at
    FROM emr_device d
    WHERE d.deleted = FALSE
      AND d.care_type IN ('dicom', 'dicom-enabler')
    GROUP BY d.facility_id
  ),
  templates AS (
    SELECT t.facility_id, COUNT(*) AS report_templates
    FROM care_radiology_observationtemplate t
    WHERE t.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY t.facility_id
  ),
  -- The three tag displays process_mpps_webhook() looks up. A facility missing them
  -- still works, but scan progress never lands on the service request.
  mpps_tags AS (
    SELECT tc.facility_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.display) AS mpps_tags_configured
    FROM emr_tagconfig tc
    WHERE tc.deleted = FALSE
      AND tc.status = 'active'
      AND tc.display IN ('Scan Started', 'Scan Completed', 'Scan Cancelled')
      AND tc.facility_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tc.facility_id
  ),
  studies AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                           AS facility_id,
      COUNT(*)                                                                          AS imaging_orders_total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.created_date >= b.period_start AND ist.created_date < b.period_end)
                                                                                        AS imaging_orders_in_period,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ist.patient_id)                                                    AS patients_imaged_total,
      MIN(ist.created_date)                                                             AS first_order_at,
      MAX(ist.created_date)                                                             AS last_order_at
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  images AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                           AS facility_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ds.id) FILTER (WHERE ds.is_archived = FALSE)                       AS dicom_studies_live
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    JOIN care_radiology_imagingstudy ist ON ist.id = ds.imaging_study_id AND ist.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                              AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                     AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  geo.name                                                   AS "GEO_ORGANIZATION",
  COALESCE(idf.active_procedures, 0)                         AS "IMAGING_PROCEDURES",
  COALESCE(idf.procedures_without_location, 0)               AS "PROCEDURES_WITHOUT_ROOM",
  COALESCE(dv.dicom_enablers, 0)                             AS "DICOM_ENABLERS",
  COALESCE(dv.modality_devices, 0)                           AS "MODALITIES",
  COALESCE(dv.worklist_ready_modalities, 0)                  AS "MODALITIES_ON_WORKLIST",
  COALESCE(dv.assigned_modalities, 0)                        AS "MODALITIES_ASSIGNED",
  dv.last_modality_sync_at                                   AS "LAST_MODALITY_SYNC",
  COALESCE(tpl.report_templates, 0)                          AS "REPORT_TEMPLATES",
  COALESCE(tg.mpps_tags_configured, 0)                       AS "MPPS_TAGS_OF_3",
  COALESCE(s.imaging_orders_total, 0)                        AS "IMAGING_ORDERS_TOTAL",
  COALESCE(s.imaging_orders_in_period, 0)                    AS "IMAGING_ORDERS_IN_PERIOD",
  COALESCE(s.patients_imaged_total, 0)                       AS "PATIENTS_IMAGED",
  COALESCE(im.dicom_studies_live, 0)                         AS "DICOM_STUDIES_LIVE",
  (s.first_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE       AS "FIRST_ORDER_DATE",
  (s.last_order_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE        AS "LAST_ORDER_DATE",
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.imaging_orders_in_period, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(im.dicom_studies_live, 0) > 0
      THEN 'Live'
    WHEN COALESCE(s.imaging_orders_total, 0) > 0
      THEN 'Piloting'
    WHEN COALESCE(idf.active_procedures, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(dv.worklist_ready_modalities, 0) > 0
      THEN 'Configured, no orders'
    WHEN COALESCE(idf.active_procedures, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(dv.modality_devices, 0) > 0
      THEN 'Partially configured'
    ELSE 'Not onboarded'
  END                                                        AS "ROLLOUT_STAGE",
  -- Blockers worth chasing before a facility is called live.
  NULLIF(
    CONCAT_WS(
      '; ',
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(idf.active_procedures, 0) = 0 THEN 'no imaging procedures' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(idf.procedures_without_location, 0) > 0 THEN 'procedures with no room' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(dv.worklist_ready_modalities, 0) = 0 THEN 'no worklist-ready modality' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(dv.dicom_enablers, 0) = 0 THEN 'no DICOM enabler' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(tpl.report_templates, 0) = 0 THEN 'no report template' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(tg.mpps_tags_configured, 0) < 3 THEN 'MPPS tags incomplete' END
    ),
    ''
  )                                                          AS "GAPS"
FROM facility_facility f
LEFT JOIN emr_organization geo ON geo.id = f.geo_organization_id AND geo.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN imaging_defs idf ON idf.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN devices dv       ON dv.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN templates tpl    ON tpl.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN mpps_tags tg     ON tg.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN studies s        ON s.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN images im        ON im.facility_id = f.id
WHERE f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
  -- Facilities with no radiology footprint at all are noise on a rollout card.
  AND (
    COALESCE(idf.active_procedures, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(dv.modality_devices, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(dv.dicom_enablers, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(s.imaging_orders_total, 0) > 0
  )
ORDER BY "IMAGING_ORDERS_IN_PERIOD" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";

card.name: Imaging Order Volume (daily)
card.description: Orders per facility, day and procedure, with the lifecycle status mix.

stages.native:
-- KPI 2: Imaging Order Volume (daily, by facility and procedure)
--
-- The "is it being used, and is usage growing?" trend card. One row per
-- facility x day x procedure, with the lifecycle status mix for that bucket.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  orders AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                   AS facility_id,
      (ist.created_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE                      AS order_date,
      COALESCE(ad.title, sr.title, 'Unspecified procedure')                     AS procedure_title,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                                       AS procedure_category,
      ist.status                                                                AS study_status,
      sr.priority                                                               AS priority,
      e.encounter_class                                                         AS encounter_class,
      ist.id                                                                    AS imaging_study_pk,
      ist.patient_id,
      ist.accession_number,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
        WHERE ds.imaging_study_id = ist.id AND ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
      )                                                                         AS has_images,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
        WHERE dr.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id
          AND dr.deleted = FALSE AND dr.status = 'final'
      )                                                                         AS has_final_report
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                         AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                                AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  o.order_date                                                          AS "ORDER_DATE",
  o.procedure_category                                                  AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  o.procedure_title                                                     AS "PROCEDURE",
  COUNT(*)                                                              AS "ORDERS",
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id)                                          AS "PATIENTS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.encounter_class = 'amb')                     AS "OUTPATIENT_ORDERS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.priority IN ('urgent', 'asap', 'stat'))      AS "URGENT_ORDERS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.study_status = 'ACTIVE')                     AS "STATUS_ACTIVE",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.study_status = 'IN_PROGRESS')                AS "STATUS_IN_PROGRESS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.study_status = 'COMPLETED')                  AS "STATUS_COMPLETED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.study_status = 'CANCELLED')                  AS "STATUS_CANCELLED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.has_images)                                  AS "WITH_IMAGES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.has_final_report)                            AS "WITH_FINAL_REPORT",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.accession_number IS NULL)                    AS "MISSING_ACCESSION",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.has_images) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)
                                                                        AS "IMAGED_PCT",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.has_final_report) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)
                                                                        AS "REPORTED_PCT"
FROM orders o
JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = o.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY
  f.external_id, f.name, o.order_date, o.procedure_category, o.procedure_title
ORDER BY
  "ORDER_DATE" DESC, "ORDERS" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";

card.name: Imaging Study Funnel
card.description: Order -> accession -> scan -> images -> report, with the drop-off at each stage.

stages.native:
-- KPI 3: Imaging Study Funnel (order -> accession -> scan -> images -> report)
--
-- Where orders fall out of the pipeline, per facility. Each stage is a subset of
-- the one before it, so the drop between two columns is the leak to investigate.
--
-- Stage sources:
--   ORDERED        care_radiology_imagingstudy row (created by the ServiceRequest post_save signal)
--   ACCESSIONED    accession_number set by the assign_accession_number Celery task
--   SCAN_STARTED   MPPS webhook log with study_status IN_PROGRESS, or a study past ACTIVE
--   IMAGES_STORED  at least one non-archived care_radiology_dicomstudy
--   REPORT_DRAFTED emr_diagnosticreport in any status
--   REPORT_FINAL   emr_diagnosticreport with status 'final'
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  -- The MPPS webhook log is the only record of when a scan started or finished:
  -- ImagingStudy keeps a single status column with no per-transition timestamp.
  -- Joined on text, not ::uuid, so a malformed payload cannot abort the query.
  mpps AS (
    SELECT
      LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')                                        AS sr_external_id,
      BOOL_OR(w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'IN_PROGRESS')                            AS scan_started,
      BOOL_OR(w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'COMPLETED')                              AS scan_completed
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.type = 'MPPS'
      AND w.raw_data ? 'service_request_id'
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  studies AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                           AS facility_id,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                                               AS procedure_category,
      ist.id,
      ist.status,
      ist.accession_number IS NOT NULL                                                  AS accessioned,
      COALESCE(m.scan_started, FALSE)
        OR ist.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED')                                   AS scan_started,
      COALESCE(m.scan_completed, FALSE)
        OR ist.status = 'COMPLETED'                                                     AS scan_completed,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
        WHERE ds.imaging_study_id = ist.id AND ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
      )                                                                                 AS images_stored,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
        WHERE dr.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id AND dr.deleted = FALSE
      )                                                                                 AS report_drafted,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
        WHERE dr.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id
          AND dr.deleted = FALSE AND dr.status = 'final'
      )                                                                                 AS report_final
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN mpps m                     ON m.sr_external_id = sr.external_id::TEXT
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                     AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                            AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  s.procedure_category                                              AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS "ORDERED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.accessioned)                             AS "ACCESSIONED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.scan_started)                            AS "SCAN_STARTED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.scan_completed)                          AS "SCAN_COMPLETED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.images_stored)                           AS "IMAGES_STORED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.report_drafted)                          AS "REPORT_DRAFTED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.report_final)                            AS "REPORT_FINAL",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'CANCELLED')                    AS "CANCELLED",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.images_stored) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)
                                                                    AS "ORDER_TO_IMAGE_PCT",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.report_final)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.images_stored), 0), 1)    AS "IMAGE_TO_REPORT_PCT",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.report_final) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)
                                                                    AS "END_TO_END_PCT",
  -- Scanned but nothing in the PACS: the usual sign of a DICOM Enabler or
  -- accession-number mismatch rather than a clinical delay.
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.scan_completed AND NOT s.images_stored)  AS "SCANNED_NO_IMAGES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.images_stored AND NOT s.report_drafted)  AS "IMAGED_NOT_REPORTED"
FROM studies s
JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = s.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY f.external_id, f.name, s.procedure_category
ORDER BY "ORDERED" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";

card.name: Turnaround Time Summary (p50 / p90)
card.description: Median and p90 hours per leg. The *_N columns say how many studies each percentile is based on.

stages.native:
-- KPI 5: Turnaround Time Summary (median / p90 per facility and procedure)
--
-- The headline SLA card. Same clocks as KPI 4 -- read its header for what each
-- timestamp actually measures before quoting these numbers to anyone.
-- Percentiles are computed only over studies that reached the stage, so the
-- *_N columns are there to tell a fast median from a thin one.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  mpps AS (
    SELECT
      LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')                                       AS sr_external_id,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS scan_started_at,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'COMPLETED')   AS scan_ended_at
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.type = 'MPPS'
      AND w.raw_data ? 'service_request_id'
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  images AS (
    SELECT ds.imaging_study_id, MIN(ds.created_date) AS first_image_at
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY ds.imaging_study_id
  ),
  reports AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (dr.service_request_id)
      dr.service_request_id,
      dr.modified_date AS report_final_at
    FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
    WHERE dr.deleted = FALSE AND dr.status = 'final'
    ORDER BY dr.service_request_id, dr.modified_date
  ),
  legs AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                     AS facility_id,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                                         AS procedure_category,
      sr.priority                                                                 AS priority,
      ist.status                                                                  AS study_status,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.scan_started_at - ist.created_date)) / 3600.0         AS order_to_scan_hrs,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (im.first_image_at
                          - COALESCE(m.scan_ended_at, m.scan_started_at, ist.created_date))) / 3600.0
                                                                                  AS scan_to_images_hrs,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.report_final_at - im.first_image_at)) / 3600.0        AS images_to_report_hrs,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.report_final_at - ist.created_date)) / 3600.0         AS total_tat_hrs
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN mpps m                     ON m.sr_external_id = sr.external_id::TEXT
    LEFT JOIN images im                  ON im.imaging_study_id = ist.id
    LEFT JOIN reports r                  ON r.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.status <> 'CANCELLED'
      AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                                 AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                                        AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  l.procedure_category                                                          AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  COUNT(*)                                                                      AS "STUDIES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.priority IN ('urgent', 'asap', 'stat'))              AS "URGENT_STUDIES",

  COUNT(l.order_to_scan_hrs)                                                    AS "ORDER_TO_SCAN_N",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.order_to_scan_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "ORDER_TO_SCAN_P50_HRS",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.order_to_scan_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "ORDER_TO_SCAN_P90_HRS",

  COUNT(l.scan_to_images_hrs)                                                   AS "SCAN_TO_IMAGES_N",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.scan_to_images_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "SCAN_TO_IMAGES_P50_HRS",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.scan_to_images_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "SCAN_TO_IMAGES_P90_HRS",

  COUNT(l.images_to_report_hrs)                                                 AS "IMAGES_TO_REPORT_N",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.images_to_report_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "IMAGES_TO_REPORT_P50_HRS",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.images_to_report_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "IMAGES_TO_REPORT_P90_HRS",

  COUNT(l.total_tat_hrs)                                                        AS "TOTAL_TAT_N",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.total_tat_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "TOTAL_TAT_P50_HRS",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.total_tat_hrs)::NUMERIC, 2)
                                                                                AS "TOTAL_TAT_P90_HRS",
  -- Share of studies reported within a day of the order being raised.
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.total_tat_hrs <= 24) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)
                                                                                AS "REPORTED_WITHIN_24H_PCT"
FROM legs l
JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = l.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY f.external_id, f.name, l.procedure_category
ORDER BY "STUDIES" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";

card.name: Turnaround Time by Study
card.description: Study-level drill-through behind the TAT summary. Filter CURRENT_STAGE to isolate a queue.

stages.native:
-- KPI 4: Radiology Turnaround Time (study level)
--
-- One row per imaging study with each leg of the journey in hours. This is the
-- drill-through table behind the TAT summary; export it to chase outliers.
--
-- Clock sources, and what each really measures:
--   ORDERED_AT       care_radiology_imagingstudy.created_date  (order placed in CARE)
--   SCAN_STARTED_AT  first MPPS webhook log with study_status IN_PROGRESS
--   SCAN_ENDED_AT    first MPPS webhook log with study_status COMPLETED
--   IMAGES_AT        earliest care_radiology_dicomstudy.created_date -- when the upload
--                    landed in CARE, NOT the DICOM acquisition time (that lives in the
--                    PACS, which CARE never copies into its own tables)
--   REPORT_FINAL_AT  emr_diagnosticreport.modified_date of the first report that reached
--                    status 'final'. DiagnosticReport carries no finalised_at column, so
--                    a report edited after finalisation reports its last edit instead.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  mpps AS (
    SELECT
      LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')                                     AS sr_external_id,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS scan_started_at,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'COMPLETED')   AS scan_ended_at,
      COUNT(*)                                                                       AS mpps_events
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.type = 'MPPS'
      AND w.raw_data ? 'service_request_id'
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  images AS (
    SELECT
      ds.imaging_study_id,
      MIN(ds.created_date)                            AS first_image_at,
      MAX(ds.created_date)                            AS last_image_at,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.is_archived = FALSE)  AS live_studies,
      SUM(ds.number_of_series)                        AS series,
      SUM(ds.number_of_instances)                     AS instances
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY ds.imaging_study_id
  ),
  reports AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (dr.service_request_id)
      dr.service_request_id,
      dr.modified_date      AS report_final_at,
      dr.created_date       AS report_started_at,
      dr.updated_by_id      AS reporter_id
    FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
    WHERE dr.deleted = FALSE
      AND dr.status = 'final'
    ORDER BY dr.service_request_id, dr.modified_date
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                     AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                            AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  ist.external_id                                                   AS "IMAGING_STUDY_ID",
  ist.accession_number                                              AS "ACCESSION_NUMBER",
  p.external_id                                                     AS "PATIENT_ID",
  COALESCE(ad.title, sr.title)                                      AS "PROCEDURE",
  COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                               AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  sr.priority                                                       AS "PRIORITY",
  e.encounter_class                                                 AS "ENCOUNTER_CLASS",
  ist.status                                                        AS "STUDY_STATUS",
  ist.created_date                                                  AS "ORDERED_AT",
  m.scan_started_at                                                 AS "SCAN_STARTED_AT",
  m.scan_ended_at                                                   AS "SCAN_ENDED_AT",
  im.first_image_at                                                 AS "IMAGES_AT",
  r.report_final_at                                                 AS "REPORT_FINAL_AT",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.scan_started_at - ist.created_date)) / 3600.0, 2)
                                                                    AS "ORDER_TO_SCAN_HRS",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.scan_ended_at - m.scan_started_at)) / 3600.0, 2)
                                                                    AS "SCAN_DURATION_HRS",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (im.first_image_at - COALESCE(m.scan_ended_at, m.scan_started_at, ist.created_date))) / 3600.0, 2)
                                                                    AS "SCAN_TO_IMAGES_HRS",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.report_final_at - im.first_image_at)) / 3600.0, 2)
                                                                    AS "IMAGES_TO_REPORT_HRS",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.report_final_at - ist.created_date)) / 3600.0, 2)
                                                                    AS "TOTAL_TAT_HRS",
  COALESCE(im.live_studies, 0)                                      AS "DICOM_STUDIES",
  im.series                                                         AS "SERIES",
  im.instances                                                      AS "INSTANCES",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', ru.first_name, ru.last_name)), ''), ru.username)
                                                                    AS "REPORTED_BY",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', qu.first_name, qu.last_name)), ''), qu.username)
                                                                    AS "ORDERED_BY",
  COALESCE(m.mpps_events, 0)                                        AS "MPPS_EVENTS",
  -- The stage a study is sitting in, for filtering the table down to a queue.
  CASE
    WHEN ist.status = 'CANCELLED'          THEN 'Cancelled'
    WHEN r.report_final_at IS NOT NULL     THEN 'Reported'
    WHEN im.first_image_at IS NOT NULL     THEN 'Awaiting report'
    WHEN m.scan_ended_at IS NOT NULL       THEN 'Awaiting images'
    WHEN m.scan_started_at IS NOT NULL     THEN 'Scan in progress'
    WHEN ist.accession_number IS NOT NULL  THEN 'Awaiting scan'
    ELSE 'Awaiting accession number'
  END                                                               AS "CURRENT_STAGE"
FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
CROSS JOIN bounds b
LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
JOIN emr_patient p                   ON p.id = ist.patient_id
JOIN facility_facility f             ON f.id = COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id) AND f.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN users_user qu              ON qu.id = sr.requester_id
LEFT JOIN mpps m                     ON m.sr_external_id = sr.external_id::TEXT
LEFT JOIN images im                  ON im.imaging_study_id = ist.id
LEFT JOIN reports r                  ON r.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id
LEFT JOIN users_user ru              ON ru.id = r.reporter_id
WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
  AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
  AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
ORDER BY ist.created_date DESC;

card.name: Open Backlog & Aging
card.description: Every open study with its age and blocking stage. Ignores the date filter on purpose.

stages.native:
-- KPI 6: Open Radiology Backlog & Aging
--
-- The daily ops queue: every non-cancelled, non-reported study with how long it
-- has been sitting and which stage it is stuck at. Unlike the other cards this
-- one ignores {{start_date}}/{{end_date}} on purpose -- a backlog is about what
-- is open *now*, and the oldest items are the ones that matter most.
--
-- Parameters: {{facility_id}} (optional), {{min_age_hours}} (optional, default 0)
WITH
  mpps AS (
    SELECT
      LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')                                       AS sr_external_id,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS scan_started_at,
      MIN(w.created_date) FILTER (WHERE w.raw_data ->> 'study_status' = 'COMPLETED')   AS scan_ended_at
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.type = 'MPPS'
      AND w.raw_data ? 'service_request_id'
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  images AS (
    SELECT ds.imaging_study_id, MIN(ds.created_date) AS first_image_at, COUNT(*) AS dicom_studies
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
    GROUP BY ds.imaging_study_id
  ),
  open_studies AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                     AS facility_id,
      ist.external_id                                             AS imaging_study_id,
      ist.accession_number,
      ist.status                                                  AS study_status,
      ist.created_date                                            AS ordered_at,
      sr.status                                                   AS service_request_status,
      sr.priority,
      p.name                                                      AS patient_name,
      p.external_id                                               AS patient_external_id,
      e.encounter_class,
      COALESCE(ad.title, sr.title)                                AS procedure_title,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                         AS procedure_category,
      m.scan_started_at,
      m.scan_ended_at,
      im.first_image_at,
      COALESCE(im.dicom_studies, 0)                               AS dicom_studies,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', qu.first_name, qu.last_name)), ''), qu.username)
                                                                  AS ordered_by,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ist.created_date)) / 3600.0     AS age_hours
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    JOIN emr_patient p                   ON p.id = ist.patient_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN users_user qu              ON qu.id = sr.requester_id
    LEFT JOIN mpps m                     ON m.sr_external_id = sr.external_id::TEXT
    LEFT JOIN images im                  ON im.imaging_study_id = ist.id
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.status <> 'CANCELLED'
      -- Not yet closed out clinically.
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
        WHERE dr.service_request_id = ist.service_request_id
          AND dr.deleted = FALSE AND dr.status = 'final'
      )
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                   AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                          AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  o.imaging_study_id                              AS "IMAGING_STUDY_ID",
  o.accession_number                              AS "ACCESSION_NUMBER",
  o.patient_external_id                           AS "PATIENT_ID",
  o.patient_name                                  AS "PATIENT_NAME",
  o.procedure_category                            AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  o.procedure_title                               AS "PROCEDURE",
  o.priority                                      AS "PRIORITY",
  o.encounter_class                               AS "ENCOUNTER_CLASS",
  o.study_status                                  AS "STUDY_STATUS",
  o.service_request_status                        AS "ORDER_STATUS",
  o.ordered_by                                    AS "ORDERED_BY",
  o.ordered_at                                    AS "ORDERED_AT",
  ROUND(o.age_hours::NUMERIC, 1)                  AS "AGE_HOURS",
  CASE
    WHEN o.age_hours < 4    THEN '0-4h'
    WHEN o.age_hours < 24   THEN '4-24h'
    WHEN o.age_hours < 72   THEN '1-3d'
    WHEN o.age_hours < 168  THEN '3-7d'
    ELSE '7d+'
  END                                             AS "AGE_BUCKET",
  CASE
    WHEN o.accession_number IS NULL   THEN 'Awaiting accession number'
    WHEN o.first_image_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Awaiting report'
    WHEN o.scan_ended_at IS NOT NULL  THEN 'Awaiting images'
    WHEN o.scan_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Scan in progress'
    ELSE 'Awaiting scan'
  END                                             AS "BLOCKED_AT",
  o.dicom_studies                                 AS "DICOM_STUDIES"
FROM open_studies o
JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = o.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND o.age_hours >= {{min_age_hours}}::NUMERIC]]
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN o.priority IN ('stat', 'asap') THEN 0 WHEN o.priority = 'urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  o.age_hours DESC;

card.name: MPPS Webhook Volume (daily)
card.description: Modality -> CARE integration heartbeat. A gap here freezes every study at ACTIVE.

stages.native:
-- KPI 11: MPPS Webhook Volume (daily)
--
-- The modality -> CARE integration heartbeat. A day with orders but no MPPS
-- events means the DICOM Enabler stopped calling, which silently freezes every
-- study at ACTIVE and makes the TAT cards look like a reporting problem.
--
-- The log row is written after payload validation but BEFORE the status is
-- applied, so LOGGED is "accepted", not "applied" -- compare it with APPLIED.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  events AS (
    SELECT
      (w.created_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE          AS event_date,
      w.type                                                      AS webhook_type,
      w.raw_data ->> 'study_status'                               AS study_status,
      LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')                  AS sr_external_id,
      w.created_by_id,
      w.id
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND w.created_date <  b.period_end
  )
SELECT
  e.event_date                                                                  AS "EVENT_DATE",
  e.webhook_type                                                                AS "WEBHOOK_TYPE",
  COUNT(*)                                                                      AS "LOGGED",
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.sr_external_id)                                              AS "DISTINCT_ORDERS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.study_status = 'IN_PROGRESS')                        AS "SCAN_STARTED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.study_status = 'COMPLETED')                          AS "SCAN_COMPLETED",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.study_status = 'CANCELLED')                          AS "SCAN_CANCELLED",
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.created_by_id)                                               AS "SERVICE_ACCOUNTS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.id IS NOT NULL)                                    AS "MATCHED_TO_STUDY",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.id IS NULL)                                        AS "UNMATCHED",
  -- Applied = the study actually carries (or has moved past) the status sent.
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE ist.status = e.study_status
       OR (e.study_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND ist.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
  )                                                                             AS "APPLIED"
FROM events e
LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr       ON sr.external_id::TEXT = e.sr_external_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
                                      ON ist.service_request_id = sr.id AND ist.deleted = FALSE
GROUP BY e.event_date, e.webhook_type
ORDER BY "EVENT_DATE" DESC;

card.name: Integration & Data-Quality Exceptions
card.description: Silent failures nobody will report: missing accessions, scanned-but-no-images, unmatched webhooks.

stages.native:
-- KPI 10: Integration Health & Data-Quality Exceptions
--
-- One row per exception class per facility, with a count and the oldest example.
-- This is the card to watch in the first weeks after go-live: everything here is
-- a silent failure that no user will report.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  study_facility AS (
    SELECT
      ist.id,
      ist.external_id,
      ist.accession_number,
      ist.status,
      ist.created_date,
      ist.service_request_id,
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id) AS facility_id
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e            ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
  ),
  exceptions AS (
    -- The accession-number Celery task never ran or failed: the study can never be
    -- matched to an incoming DICOM file.
    SELECT 'Missing accession number'                AS exception_type,
           'Celery / assign_accession_number'        AS likely_cause,
           s.facility_id, s.external_id AS ref, s.created_date
    FROM study_facility s
    WHERE s.accession_number IS NULL
      AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED'

    UNION ALL
    -- ImagingStudy.service_request is nullable; a study without one is invisible to
    -- the worklist and to every report join.
    SELECT 'Imaging study with no service request', 'Order deleted or signal race',
           s.facility_id, s.external_id, s.created_date
    FROM study_facility s
    WHERE s.service_request_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL
    -- Two studies sharing an accession number break DICOM linkage both ways.
    SELECT 'Duplicate accession number', 'Sequence collision / manual edit',
           s.facility_id, s.external_id, s.created_date
    FROM study_facility s
    WHERE s.accession_number IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy o
        WHERE o.deleted = FALSE
          AND o.accession_number = s.accession_number
          AND o.id <> s.id
      )

    UNION ALL
    -- Marked COMPLETED by MPPS but nothing ever reached the PACS.
    SELECT 'Completed with no images', 'DICOM Enabler / STOW-RS upload',
           s.facility_id, s.external_id, s.created_date
    FROM study_facility s
    WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
        WHERE ds.imaging_study_id = s.id AND ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
      )

    UNION ALL
    -- Images arrived against an order that was later revoked; usually a relink candidate.
    SELECT 'Images on a cancelled order', 'Order cancelled after scan',
           s.facility_id, s.external_id, s.created_date
    FROM study_facility s
    WHERE s.status = 'CANCELLED'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
        WHERE ds.imaging_study_id = s.id AND ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
      )

    UNION ALL
    -- Study metadata never synced back from DCM4CHEE: no series/instance counts,
    -- so storage reporting under-counts and the viewer may show an empty study.
    SELECT 'DICOM study never synced from PACS', 'DCM4CHEE metadata sync',
           COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id), ds.external_id, ds.created_date
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    JOIN care_radiology_imagingstudy ist ON ist.id = ds.imaging_study_id AND ist.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE
      AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
      AND ds.number_of_instances IS NULL
      AND ds.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ds.created_date <  b.period_end

    UNION ALL
    -- MPPS webhook accepted and logged, but no imaging study carries that status.
    -- The log row is written before process_mpps_webhook() runs, so a 404 or a
    -- tag-config failure leaves exactly this footprint.
    SELECT 'MPPS event with no matching study', 'Webhook payload / facility mismatch',
           NULL::BIGINT, w.external_id, w.created_date
    FROM care_radiology_radiologywebhooklogs w
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    WHERE w.deleted = FALSE
      AND w.type = 'MPPS'
      AND w.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND w.created_date <  b.period_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
        JOIN emr_servicerequest sr ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id
        WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
          AND sr.external_id::TEXT = LOWER(w.raw_data ->> 'service_request_id')
      )
  )
SELECT
  COALESCE(f.external_id::TEXT, '(unattributed)')  AS "FACILITY_ID",
  COALESCE(f.name, '(unattributed)')               AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  x.exception_type                                 AS "EXCEPTION",
  x.likely_cause                                   AS "LIKELY_CAUSE",
  COUNT(*)                                         AS "COUNT",
  MIN(x.created_date)                              AS "OLDEST",
  MAX(x.created_date)                              AS "NEWEST",
  (ARRAY_AGG(x.ref ORDER BY x.created_date))[1]    AS "OLDEST_RECORD_ID"
FROM exceptions x
LEFT JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = x.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND COALESCE(f.external_id::TEXT, '') = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY f.external_id, f.name, x.exception_type, x.likely_cause
ORDER BY "COUNT" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";

card.name: Modality & DICOM Enabler Inventory
card.description: Device roster, worklist eligibility and last sync. Volume columns are ROOM volume, not per-machine.

stages.native:
-- KPI 7: Modality & DICOM Enabler Inventory
--
-- Every registered imaging device, its worklist eligibility, and the volume of
-- the room it stands in.
--
-- IMPORTANT: CARE stores no link from an imaging study to the device that
-- acquired it. The worklist matches a service request to a device by room
-- (ActivityDefinition.locations overlapping Device.current_location), so the
-- volume columns below are ROOM volume, shared by every device in that room --
-- not per-machine throughput. True per-machine counts need the Station Name in
-- the PACS, which CARE does not copy into its own tables.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  -- Studies attributed to a room via the ordered procedure's location list.
  room_volume AS (
    SELECT
      loc.id                                            AS location_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ist.id)                            AS studies_in_period,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ist.id) FILTER (
        WHERE EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
          WHERE ds.imaging_study_id = ist.id AND ds.deleted = FALSE AND ds.is_archived = FALSE
        )
      )                                                 AS imaged_in_period
    FROM care_radiology_imagingstudy ist
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc   ON loc.id = ANY (ad.locations) AND loc.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE ist.deleted = FALSE
      AND ist.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ist.created_date <  b.period_end
    GROUP BY loc.id
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                       AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                              AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  d.external_id                                                       AS "DEVICE_ID",
  d.care_type                                                         AS "DEVICE_KIND",
  COALESCE(d.user_friendly_name, d.registered_name)                   AS "DEVICE_NAME",
  d.manufacturer                                                      AS "MANUFACTURER",
  d.model_number                                                      AS "MODEL",
  d.metadata -> 'machine' ->> 'modality'                              AS "MODALITY",
  d.metadata -> 'machine' ->> 'ae_title'                              AS "AE_TITLE",
  d.metadata ->> 'ip'                                                 AS "IP",
  d.status                                                            AS "DEVICE_STATUS",
  d.availability_status                                               AS "AVAILABILITY",
  COALESCE(d.metadata ->> 'assignment_status', 'unassigned')          AS "ASSIGNMENT_STATUS",
  loc.name                                                            AS "ROOM",
  enabler.registered_name                                             AS "DICOM_ENABLER",
  -- Guarded cast: last_synced_at is free-form JSON, so anything that is not an
  -- ISO timestamp is read as "never synced" rather than aborting the card.
  CASE WHEN d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
       THEN (d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ END        AS "LAST_SYNCED_AT",
  CASE WHEN d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (d.metadata ->> 'last_synced_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ)) / 3600.0, 1)
  END                                                                 AS "HOURS_SINCE_SYNC",
  -- worklist_devices(): active + available + placed in a room.
  CASE
    WHEN d.care_type <> 'dicom' THEN 'n/a'
    WHEN d.status = 'active' AND d.availability_status = 'available' AND d.current_location_id IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END                                                                 AS "ON_WORKLIST",
  COALESCE(rv.studies_in_period, 0)                                   AS "ROOM_STUDIES_IN_PERIOD",
  COALESCE(rv.imaged_in_period, 0)                                    AS "ROOM_STUDIES_IMAGED",
  d.created_date                                                      AS "REGISTERED_AT"
FROM emr_device d
JOIN facility_facility f        ON f.id = d.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.id = d.current_location_id AND loc.deleted = FALSE
-- A DICOM device points at its enabler by the enabler's external_id, held as text in metadata.
LEFT JOIN emr_device enabler    ON enabler.external_id::TEXT = d.metadata ->> 'dicom_enabler'
                                AND enabler.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN room_volume rv        ON rv.location_id = d.current_location_id
WHERE d.deleted = FALSE
  AND d.care_type IN ('dicom', 'dicom-enabler')
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
ORDER BY "FACILITY_NAME", "DEVICE_KIND", "DEVICE_NAME";

card.name: PACS Storage Growth & Archival
card.description: DICOM instances accumulating per facility per month, with archival and unsynced studies.

stages.native:
-- KPI 8: PACS Storage Growth & Archival
--
-- How much imaging is accumulating, per facility per month, and how much of it
-- has been archived out of the PACS.
--
-- NOTE: number_of_series / number_of_instances are written when CARE syncs a
-- study's metadata from DCM4CHEE; a study never synced leaves them NULL, which
-- is why UNSYNCED_STUDIES is on this card. Byte-level size is not kept in CARE
-- at all -- instance counts are the proxy.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  studies AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(sr.facility_id, e.facility_id)                                    AS facility_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', ds.created_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE     AS month,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                                        AS procedure_category,
      ds.is_archived,
      ds.number_of_series,
      ds.number_of_instances,
      ds.archived_datetime,
      ds.id
    FROM care_radiology_dicomstudy ds
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    JOIN care_radiology_imagingstudy ist ON ist.id = ds.imaging_study_id AND ist.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr      ON sr.id = ist.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                 ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad  ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc    ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE ds.deleted = FALSE
      AND ds.created_date >= b.period_start
      AND ds.created_date <  b.period_end
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                         AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                                AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  s.month                                                               AS "MONTH",
  s.procedure_category                                                  AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  COUNT(*)                                                              AS "DICOM_STUDIES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.is_archived)                             AS "LIVE_STUDIES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_archived)                                 AS "ARCHIVED_STUDIES",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.number_of_instances IS NULL)                 AS "UNSYNCED_STUDIES",
  COALESCE(SUM(s.number_of_series), 0)                                  AS "SERIES",
  COALESCE(SUM(s.number_of_instances), 0)                               AS "INSTANCES",
  COALESCE(SUM(s.number_of_instances) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.is_archived), 0)
                                                                        AS "LIVE_INSTANCES",
  ROUND(AVG(s.number_of_instances)::NUMERIC, 1)                         AS "AVG_INSTANCES_PER_STUDY",
  MAX(s.number_of_instances)                                            AS "MAX_INSTANCES_IN_A_STUDY",
  -- Running total within a facility+category series, so the card doubles as a
  -- capacity-planning line chart. Partitioned by category because that is part
  -- of the grain -- summing across categories here would depend on row order.
  SUM(COALESCE(SUM(s.number_of_instances) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.is_archived), 0))
    OVER (PARTITION BY f.external_id, s.procedure_category ORDER BY s.month)
                                                                        AS "CUMULATIVE_LIVE_INSTANCES"
FROM studies s
JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = s.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY f.external_id, f.name, s.month, s.procedure_category
ORDER BY "MONTH" DESC, "INSTANCES" DESC;

card.name: Reporting Productivity & Template Adoption
card.description: Reports finalised per radiologist, order-to-report latency, and share of templated observations.

stages.native:
-- KPI 9: Reporting Productivity & Template Adoption
--
-- Who is finalising radiology reports, how fast, and how much of the reporting
-- is coming from the plugin's observation templates rather than free text.
--
-- Attribution: emr_diagnosticreport.updated_by_id is the user who last wrote the
-- report, which for a finalised report is the radiologist who signed it off.
-- There is no separate "finalised_by" column, so a report edited after
-- finalisation is attributed to whoever made that last edit.
--
-- Parameters: {{start_date}}, {{end_date}} (IST dates, inclusive), {{facility_id}} (optional)
WITH
  bounds AS (
    SELECT
      ({{start_date}}::DATE)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'   AS period_start,
      ({{end_date}}::DATE + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS period_end
  ),
  -- Observation definitions that a facility has wrapped in a radiology template.
  template_defs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.facility_id, t.observation_definition_id
    FROM care_radiology_observationtemplate t
    WHERE t.deleted = FALSE
  ),
  radiology_reports AS (
    SELECT
      dr.id,
      -- DiagnosticReport.facility is nullable; fall back to the order's facility so a
      -- report with no facility set is still counted somewhere.
      COALESCE(dr.facility_id, sr.facility_id, e.facility_id) AS facility_id,
      dr.service_request_id,
      dr.status,
      dr.created_date,
      dr.modified_date,
      dr.updated_by_id,
      dr.conclusion,
      ist.created_date                                   AS ordered_at,
      COALESCE(rc.title, 'Uncategorised')                AS procedure_category
    FROM emr_diagnosticreport dr
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    -- An imaging study on the service request is what makes this a radiology report
    -- rather than a lab one.
    JOIN care_radiology_imagingstudy ist  ON ist.service_request_id = dr.service_request_id
                                         AND ist.deleted = FALSE
    JOIN emr_encounter e                  ON e.id = ist.encounter_id
    LEFT JOIN emr_servicerequest sr       ON sr.id = dr.service_request_id AND sr.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_activitydefinition ad   ON ad.id = sr.activity_definition_id AND ad.deleted = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN emr_resourcecategory rc     ON rc.id = ad.category_id AND rc.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE dr.deleted = FALSE
      AND dr.status = 'final'
      AND dr.modified_date >= b.period_start
      AND dr.modified_date <  b.period_end
  ),
  observations AS (
    SELECT
      o.diagnostic_report_id,
      COUNT(*)                                                                AS observation_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE td.observation_definition_id IS NOT NULL)        AS templated_observations
    FROM emr_observation o
    JOIN radiology_reports rr   ON rr.id = o.diagnostic_report_id
    LEFT JOIN template_defs td  ON td.observation_definition_id = o.observation_definition_id
                               AND td.facility_id = rr.facility_id
    WHERE o.deleted = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'entered_in_error'
    GROUP BY o.diagnostic_report_id
  )
SELECT
  f.external_id                                                           AS "FACILITY_ID",
  f.name                                                                  AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  u.external_id                                                           AS "REPORTER_ID",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.username)
                                                                          AS "REPORTER",
  u.user_type                                                             AS "REPORTER_TYPE",
  r.procedure_category                                                    AS "PROCEDURE_CATEGORY",
  COUNT(*)                                                                AS "REPORTS_FINALISED",
  COUNT(DISTINCT (r.modified_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE)     AS "ACTIVE_DAYS",
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT (r.modified_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE), 0),
    1
  )                                                                       AS "REPORTS_PER_ACTIVE_DAY",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
    ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.modified_date - r.ordered_at)) / 3600.0
  )::NUMERIC, 2)                                                          AS "ORDER_TO_REPORT_P50_HRS",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (
    ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.modified_date - r.ordered_at)) / 3600.0
  )::NUMERIC, 2)                                                          AS "ORDER_TO_REPORT_P90_HRS",
  COALESCE(SUM(ob.observation_count), 0)                                  AS "OBSERVATIONS_RECORDED",
  COALESCE(SUM(ob.templated_observations), 0)                             AS "TEMPLATED_OBSERVATIONS",
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(ob.templated_observations), 0)
    / NULLIF(SUM(ob.observation_count), 0), 1
  )                                                                       AS "TEMPLATE_USE_PCT",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(r.conclusion), '') <> '')          AS "REPORTS_WITH_CONCLUSION",
  MAX(r.modified_date)                                                    AS "LAST_REPORT_AT"
FROM radiology_reports r
JOIN facility_facility f  ON f.id = r.facility_id AND f.deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN users_user u    ON u.id = r.updated_by_id
LEFT JOIN observations ob ON ob.diagnostic_report_id = r.id
WHERE TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id::TEXT = {{facility_id}}]]
GROUP BY f.external_id, f.name, u.external_id, u.username, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.user_type, r.procedure_category
ORDER BY "REPORTS_FINALISED" DESC, "FACILITY_NAME";
